# Location scope: true if this location is one of the 26 World Megaproject sites.
oe_v49_wdr_is_wonder_site = {
	OR = {
		this = location:suez
		this = location:panama
		this = location:corinth
		this = location:yangzhou
		this = location:tobolsk
		this = location:london
		this = location:baghdad
		this = location:tenochtitlan
		this = location:samarkand
		this = location:poyang
		this = location:guangzhou
		this = location:quito
		this = location:alexandria
		this = location:paris
		this = location:vienna
		this = location:amsterdam
		this = location:venice
		this = location:lisbon
		this = location:neva
		this = location:delhi
		this = location:kyoto
		this = location:cairo
		this = location:timbuktu
		this = location:axum
		this = location:good_hope
		AND = {
			is_capital = yes
			continent = continent:america
			has_owner = yes
			owner ?= {
				OR = {
					religion.group = religion_group:christian
					culture ?= { has_culture_group = culture_group:greek_group }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

		AND = { owns = location:good_hope location:good_hope = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:oe_v49_wdr_cape_beacon value = 2 } } }
		any_owned_location = { location_building_level = { building_type = building_type:oe_v49_wdr_nova_hagia_sophia value = 2 } }
	}
}

# Country scope: true if country owns >= 1 Tier III Eternal Wonder or >= 2 Megaprojects.
oe_v49_wdr_qualifies_golden_age = {
	OR = {
		any_owned_location = { oe_v49_wdr_location_has_tier3 = yes }
		trigger_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = oe_v49_wdr_player_wonders }
			var:oe_v49_wdr_player_wonders >= 2
		}
		trigger_else = { always = no }
	}
}
